clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 2: covered works not conveyed; permission is unconditional while the license remains in force.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission covers making, running, and propagating a covered work that the licensee does not convey. The source distinguishes modification of a private copy from conveyance.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 2: convey a covered work solely so others make modifications exclusively for the licensee, or provide facilities for running it. This is not general downstream conveyance.
clauses.condition_explanation: All stated conditions apply. The recipient's work must be exclusively on the licensee's behalf and under its direction and control; its terms must prohibit copies of the licensee's copyrighted material outside the relationship. For material whose copyright the licensee does not control, the licensee must comply with the License when conveying it.

obligation_items.content: Do not authorize copies of the licensee's copyrighted material outside the relationship with the licensee.
obligation_items.actor: persons making or running the covered works for the licensee, under terms the licensee must impose
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever those persons make or run covered works exclusively on the licensee's behalf.

obligation_items.content: Comply with the License in conveying material whose copyright the licensee does not control.
obligation_items.object: conveyed material whose copyright the licensee does not control
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying covered works to others solely for modifications exclusively for the licensee or facilities for running those works.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 2: other conveyance is allowed only under the following sections' conditions. Sublicensing is not allowed; section 10 supplies automatic downstream licensing instead.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is a cross-reference to the applicable conditions in sections 4–6 and other relevant License terms; it is not an independent unconditional grant. Sublicensing is prohibited.

obligation_items.content: Do not sublicense the covered work.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever the licensee would otherwise sublicense it.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 3: a covered work must not be deemed part of an effective technological measure under the specified WIPO-implementing or similar anti-circumvention laws.
clauses.condition_explanation: The rule concerns the legal characterization of a covered work as part of an effective technological measure, not a general prohibition on using technological measures.

obligation_items.content: Do not deem a covered work part of an effective technological measure within the stated laws.
obligation_items.trigger: When the applicable law fulfills the stated WIPO treaty obligations or is a similar law prohibiting or restricting circumvention of such measures.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 3: waiver and disclaimer apply when the licensee conveys a covered work.
clauses.condition_explanation: The waiver reaches only circumvention effected by exercising rights under the License with respect to the covered work. The disclaimer concerns limiting operation or modification against users as a means of enforcing the licensee's or third parties' circumvention rights.

obligation_items.content: Waive legal power to forbid circumvention to the extent it is effected by exercising rights under the License with respect to the covered work.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the covered work and only to the stated extent of License-rights circumvention.

obligation_items.content: Disclaim an intention to limit operation or modification of the work as a means of enforcing the licensee's or third parties' legal rights to forbid circumvention against users.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the covered work.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 4: verbatim copies of the Program's source code as received, in any medium. Requirements attach to each copy and its recipient.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission requires all listed copy-level notice and License-delivery conditions.

obligation_items.content: Conspicuously and appropriately publish an appropriate copyright notice on each copy.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever conveying a verbatim copy under section 4.

obligation_items.content: Keep intact all notices stating that the License and any section 7 non-permissive terms apply to the code.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever conveying a verbatim copy under section 4.

obligation_items.content: Keep intact all notices of the absence of any warranty.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever conveying a verbatim copy under section 4.

obligation_items.content: Give every recipient a copy of the License along with the Program.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever conveying a verbatim copy under section 4.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 4: the licensee may charge any price or no price for each conveyed copy and may offer support or warranty protection for a fee.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is permission to charge recipients for copies and to offer paid support or warranty protection; it does not require charging or offering those services.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5: source-code conveyance of a work based on the Program or modifications to produce it; section 4 conditions also apply.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is conditional on section 4 and all applicable section 5 conditions, including the conditions stated in the following paragraphs.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5(a): applies to the modified work conveyed in source form.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both prominent notice contents are required.

obligation_items.content: Put a prominent notice on the work stating that it was modified and giving a relevant date.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the modified work under section 5.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5(b) modifies section 4's keep-intact-notices requirement for the modified work.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prominent notices must state release under this License and any section 7 conditions. The section 4 notice requirement applies as modified by section 5(b).

obligation_items.content: Put prominent notices on the work stating that it is released under this License and any conditions added under section 7.
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying the modified work under section 5.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5(c): applies to the whole modified work and all its parts regardless of packaging. Separate permission received independently is not invalidated.
clauses.condition_explanation: The entire work must be licensed under this License to anyone possessing a copy. The clause does not invalidate permission separately received to license the work another way.

obligation_items.content: License the entire work, as a whole, under this License to anyone who comes into possession of a copy.
obligation_items.object: entire modified work and all its parts, regardless of packaging
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying a copy of the work based on the Program.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5(d): applies to each interactive user interface of the work, subject to the stated exception based on the Program's interfaces.
clauses.condition_explanation: Each interface must display Appropriate Legal Notices unless the Program has interactive interfaces that do not display them; in that case the modified work need not make them do so.

obligation_items.content: Ensure each interactive user interface displays Appropriate Legal Notices.
obligation_items.object: each interactive user interface of the modified work
obligation_items.trigger: When the work has interactive user interfaces, except when the Program has interactive interfaces that do not display Appropriate Legal Notices.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 5: aggregate boundary. Inclusion of a covered work does not extend this License to other parts of the aggregate.
clauses.condition_explanation: The works must be separate and independent, not by nature extensions, and not combined into a larger program; the compilation and resulting copyright must not restrict users beyond what the individual works permit.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6: object-code conveyance requires machine-readable Corresponding Source under this License via one of the enumerated alternatives.
clauses.condition_explanation: The section 6 methods are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. Sections 4 and 5 apply as relevant to the conveyance.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6(a): one alternative method for satisfying the object-code Corresponding Source condition.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is an alternative to the other section 6 methods.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code with the Corresponding Source fixed on a durable physical medium customarily used for software interchange.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for the conveyed object-code work
obligation_items.trigger: When using section 6(a) for object code in or embodied in a physical product or distribution medium.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6(b): alternative method for physical-product object-code conveyance. The written offer is to anyone possessing the object code.
clauses.condition_explanation: The offer must last at least three years and for as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model. The recipient may receive a physical source copy for no more than reasonable physical-conveyance cost, or no-charge network access to copy the source.

obligation_items.content: Accompany the object code with a written offer to give any possessor the Corresponding Source for all covered software in the product, by one of the stated delivery choices.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for all software in the product covered by this License
obligation_items.trigger: When using section 6(b) for object code in or embodied in a physical product; the offer must remain valid for at least three years and as long as spare parts or customer support are offered for that product model.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6(c): narrow alternative for individual object-code copies, dependent on receipt under section 6(b).
clauses.condition_explanation: All three restrictions apply; this route is not a general commercial redistribution permission.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6(d): designated-place access may be gratis or for a charge. A different source server is permitted subject to the stated equivalence, directions, and continuing-availability conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: Equivalent source access must be offered through the same place and in the same way at no further charge. If hosted on another server, that server may be operated by the licensee or a third party and must support equivalent copying facilities; clear directions must appear next to the object code. The licensee remains responsible for availability for as long as required.

obligation_items.content: Offer equivalent access to copy the Corresponding Source in the same way through the same place at no further charge.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source for the object-code work
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code by access from a designated place.

obligation_items.content: If the source is hosted on a different server, ensure equivalent copying facilities and place clear directions next to the object code identifying where to find the source.
obligation_items.object: Corresponding Source and directions adjacent to the object code
obligation_items.trigger: When using a different server for the source under section 6(d).

obligation_items.content: Ensure the Corresponding Source remains available for as long as needed to satisfy the requirements.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever relying on section 6(d), regardless of who operates the source server.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6(e): peer-to-peer method depends on the section 6(d) no-charge public offering of both object code and Corresponding Source.
clauses.condition_explanation: The information must identify where both the object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under section 6(d).

obligation_items.content: Inform other peers where the object code and Corresponding Source are offered to the general public at no charge under section 6(d).
obligation_items.object: location information for the object code and Corresponding Source
obligation_items.trigger: When conveying object code by peer-to-peer transmission.

clauses.scope_note: GPL-3.0 section 6: the stated separable object-code portion need not be included in the conveyance.
clauses.condition_explanation: This is a limited exception for a separable portion whose source is excluded from Corresponding Source as a System Library.
